item.title: ICC issues final warning to Bangladesh Cricket Board over T20 World Cup; Sets deadline
item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) has given Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) a strict ultimatum to decide participation in the T20 World Cup 2026 by January 21. BCB cited security concerns in India and requested alternate venues, including Sri Lanka, which ICC rejected.

item.title: Aparna Yadav and Prateek divorce sparks sensation: The real reason behind the fallout
item.description: A fresh controversy has emerged within the Yadav family after Prateek Yadav announced his decision to divorce BJP leader Aparna Yadav through a social media post. He accused her of damaging family relationships and ignoring his mental health.

item.title: From Royal Wedding to Rift: What went wrong after Aparna-Prateek’s 14 years of marriage
item.description: The once-celebrated marriage of Aparna Yadav and Prateek Yadav has come under intense spotlight after a public divorce announcement. From a grand 2011 wedding to growing personal differences, family tensions, political ambitions, and recurring controversies, the relationship reportedly faced mounting pressure.

item.title: Silver crosses Rs 3 lakh, Gold at fresh record high; Check city-wise rates here
item.description: Gold and silver prices soared to record highs on January 19 as global tensions rattled markets. With silver crossing Rs 3 lakh and gold touching new peaks, investors rushed to safe havens. What’s driving the surge, and will prices climb further?

item.title: ‘No CM Face Yet’: CPM general secretary confirms Pinarayi to lead LDF for assembly elections; Full story here
item.description: Pinarayi Vijayan will lead the LDF into the next Kerala polls, but the CPM says it won’t name a chief ministerial face yet. With alliances, ideology clashes, and strategy talks underway, key decisions remain unresolved.

item.title: Big Breaking: Delhi High Court Turns Down Kuldeep Sengar’s Plea For Suspension Of Sentence In Unnao Rape Case
item.description: Delhi High Court dealt a major blow to Kuldeep Singh Sengar, rejecting his plea to suspend his 10-year sentence in the Unnao custodial death case. With past relief attempts blocked and appeals pending, what could be his next legal move?

item.title: ‘…Write Rama and Krishna Aartis’: Javed Akhtar’s old remarks resurface amid AR Rahman ‘Communal’ controversy
item.description: Veteran lyricist Javed Akhtar’s old statements have resurfaced online after A. R. Rahman hinted at “communal” reasons behind reduced work in Hindi cinema. Akhtar’s past remarks on atheism, writing devotional songs, and growing up amid Ganga-Jamuni tehzeeb are being widely shared.

item.title: Hurry up! India’s only fair offering massive discounts on hatchbacks to luxury cars
item.description: India’s famous trade fair in Gwalior has become a major attraction for automobile buyers, offering up to 50% road tax exemption on vehicles. Held annually during December–January, the fair features bikes, cars, and luxury models from leading brands.

item.title: New BJP president? Nitin Nabin files nomination amid NDA show of strength, Results tomorrow
item.description: BJP’s national president race heats up as Nitin Nabin files nomination, backed by top leaders and several state CMs. With the party set to announce results on January 20, could Nabin become the youngest BJP chief ever?

item.title: Best Smartphones Under Rs 10,000: Top 5 deals in Amazon Republic Day Sale 2026
item.description: The Amazon Republic Day Sale 2026 is offering massive discounts on budget smartphones priced under ₹10,000. Buyers can choose from 5G phones, large-battery devices, and high-refresh-rate displays from popular brands like Redmi, Samsung, Realme, and Lava.
